facts.fact: Minister Salima Bah said the government has passed the National Broadband Strategy, a plan for rolling out data access across Sierra Leone.
Minister Salima Bah said the government has implemented the National Innovation Digital Strategy and the National Digital Development Policy.
Minister Salima Bah claimed achievements under the digital agenda, such as fibre to 14 districts and 4G coverage of 87%, measured against no stated strategy target.
Minister Salima Bah said the fibre backbone grew from 8 to 14 districts through a 1,641 km fibre rollout.

SLE.note: Only a capacity increase from 80GB to 500GB is stated; no cable or route is named.
